lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized in vertical columns immediately posterior to the branchial slits, transitioning into a dense, semi-regular grid of local maxima across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs on the mid-flank, creating a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the superior aspect and shadow-induced lower intensity on the inferior aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated on the visible surface of the left pectoral fin.
